annotations.title: Check a price on the vendor page now

description: Read the vendor's pricing page now and check the stored prices against it. Returns each plan's result, the read date and a hash of the page. Works without a key: 3 live reads a day (20 with a free key). A page read in the last 24 hours is answered from that read.

context.description: Optional. In a few words, what the user is trying to do. No names, emails or other personal data.

name: verify_price

confirmed.description: Every stored paid price is printed on the page
